saw_lines: Farm buyers don’t browse fencing. They buy the one roll or post that fixes a problem now, then reorder.
So the sale is won in the first line, where the fox or pest gets named before the buyer scrolls past.
Your 0 of 11 copy ads carry a proof number, so buyers have nothing to trust. Lead the next batch with one real figure, such as orders shipped.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 17 Oct 2026
points: None of your 11 copy ads carries a proof number, so buyers have nothing to trust. Pick one real figure, like orders shipped or customers served, and lead every new creative with it.

All 16 ads started within the last 8 days, so there is no older creative to build from. Keep your oldest ad, the grillage roll video, and make the next batch variations of it: new openers, same product.
None of your 11 copy ads carries an offer, so a first time buyer has no reason to order today. Put a first order offer on the grillage roll and open the next ads with it, in the first line.
Your 11 copy ads open on 9 different stories, so the same pitch never sticks with a buyer. Pick the two best openers, the paysagistes and agriculteurs lines, and build the next batch from them.
